coverImageAlt: A navy telescope aligns three cyan rings with a distant orange beacon above a trail of blank paper steps.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A precision telescope aligning a near objective lens with three measurable result rings and a distant completion beacon, expressing traceable objectives that resolve into concrete work.
Scene/backdrop: Quiet slate observatory workbench opening onto a warm-paper horizon, free of charts, labels, and screens.
Subject: One dominant navy telescope in profile; through its open optical path, three cyan nested rings align with a small orange beacon, while a few descending paper tabs beneath the instrument imply tasks and subtasks without symbols.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; sculpted paper, brushed metal, machined rings, and subtle handcrafted imperfections.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong horizontal silhouette and generous negative space; optical elements large and unmistakable at approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, with controlled cyan rim light and a restrained orange point of completion.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: matte painted metal, warm card stock, frosted glass without markings, fine paper fibers.
Constraints: original image; one dominant metaphor; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: target labels, scale markings, dashboard charts, space fantasy, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, clutter, tiny illegible elements, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back so the complete telescope, its base, all optical rings, and the distant beacon fit comfortably inside the inner 84% of the image with a visible quiet border on all four sides; keep the same horizontal alignment metaphor, blank paper tabs, and text-free tactile editorial treatment.
